svg.title: RoomSense deployment view
svg.text: Ubuntu 26.04 · every published port bound to 127.0.0.1
Not reachable from the room Wi-Fi or the internet: ufw denies incoming traffic, Tailscale Funnel is off,
and Docker publishes only on 127.0.0.1. Inside the tailnet, traffic is WireGuard-encrypted end to end.
